覆盖 = 该类事件在自己锚点上的比例（会话 / 工作 / 收尾，悬停看 n/N）；趋势 = 每天的事件条数；红底 = 现在就该处理；灰条 = 按需，条件触发不评判。

AI 主动上报

诊断 · 哪些工具在一线是哑的

灯色 = 该工作活跃时长 ÷ 同类型同难度基线：< 0.6 绿 · 0.6–1.5 黄 · ≥ 1.5 红。数字由事件机械生成，归因只引用 AI 自述。
健康度：环形图 = 正常 / 偏低 / 要处理 / 按需+未上线 的构成；表格按必采、按需、未上线分组，覆盖条颜色 = 状态，红条所在行加红底。「只看异常」收掉正常行；「复制修复指令」把问题、证据、卡片拼成一段话，可直接丢给 AI。指标全部从事件派生，不新增采集。

Health composition

—Normal

Passive collection

Coverage = the share of this event type seen on its own anchor (session / work / end; hover for n/N); trend = events per day; red background = needs action now; gray bar = on demand, condition-triggered and not judged.

AI self-reports

Closure = the share of started work that has ended; coverage = the work-scope measure; trend as on the left.

Diagnosis · which tools are silent in the field

Lamp color = the work's active time ÷ the baseline for the same type and difficulty: < 0.6 green · 0.6–1.5 yellow · ≥ 1.5 red. Numbers come mechanically from events; attribution quotes only the AI's own account.
Health: the donut = the mix of normal / low / needs action / on demand + not shipped; the table groups by required, on demand, and not shipped, meter color = status, rows with a red meter get a red background. “Only issues” folds away the normal rows; “Copy fix brief” joins problem, evidence, and card into one paragraph you can hand straight to an AI. Every metric derives from events, with no extra collection.
Natural-day start: 今天 = 0 点，7 天 = 含今天在内的 7 个自然日。
Natural-day start: today = local midnight, 7 days = the 7 calendar days that include today.
